intent.raw: Speed up the remaining emits facet analysis through a governed parallel research fan-out.
intent.objective: Determine, from exact current DomainSpec v2 evidence, which seven remaining emits facets are source-determined and which require genuine owner Decision Gates, then produce one dependency-aware facet matrix with aligned examples and no semantic selection.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Seven remaining facets span three separable evidence corpora and require synthesis plus adversarial review.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Three explorers run concurrently, then separate synthesis, attack, writing, and audit stages preserve evidence quality and owner gates.
context: N33-N35 are selected only on the Design surface; seven packet facets remain unresolved.
The run classifies evidence and gate shapes but cannot select semantics or project into the packet.

briefing.angle: Constraint-evidence corpus: numeric_bounds, closure, and partial_view, with D01/D02 proof-scope and completeness obligations kept separate from runtime and representation.

roles.purpose: Non-vacuity attack: require a positive and hostile witness whose validator or generator behavior differs for every admitted conclusion or gate.

briefing.angle: Non-vacuity attack: require a positive and hostile witness whose validator or generator behavior differs for every admitted conclusion or gate.
briefing.instructions: Review the synthesized emits facet matrix under the non-vacuity gate. Require every source-determined conclusion and every proposed owner option to produce a distinct validator, generator, or evaluation consequence on the same canonical Entity-to-Event facts. Demand aligned low/medium/complex positive and hostile witnesses and exact selectors. Kill any gate whose alternatives cannot be distinguished, and reject one_to_many-to-number inference, observed-subgraph PASS without closure proof, Event-Sourcing assumptions, and packet mutation claims. Return bounded repairs with task_status and domain_gate_status separate. Do not edit files.

steps.name: Parallel emits facet source exploration
stop_conditions: stop if any explorer cannot bind a load-bearing claim to an exact current source

steps.name: Seven-facet exact-binding synthesis
stop_conditions: stop unless all explorer receipts are joined and research.md is mechanically appended
stop if synthesis selects an owner option

steps.name: Precedent, non-vacuity, and definitional attack
stop_conditions: stop if a source or selector gap lacks eligible explorer feedback
stop if review globalizes another relation policy
convergence_criteria: Every seven-facet row has an exact selector and distinct consequence or is explicitly blocked.
No reviewer reopens N33-N35 or selects an owner option.
All remaining evidence gaps have an eligible declared repair edge or remain typed blockers.

steps.name: Write evidence-closed emits facet findings
stop_conditions: stop unless exact-binding evidence closure is READY
stop if writer changes anything except findings.md

steps.name: Audit the emits facet matrix
stop_conditions: stop on claim above proof or missing facet coverage
stop before owner selection or packet projection

gates.condition: The schema 0.8.0 sheet, material projection, current Dispatch Spec route, and two exact-digest independent tension verdicts pass, then the user replies exactly confirmed.
All three explorer receipts are joined and closed; the parent mechanically appends verbatim returns to research.md.
The synthesis covers all seven facets, preserves exact selectors and disagreements, and makes no owner selection.
All three skeptic receipts are joined and exact-binding evidence closure is READY before writer admission.
findings.md and writer receipt exist, cover seven facets and aligned examples, and change no forbidden surface.
Research remains non-authority and stops before semantic selection, packet projection, implementation, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production effect.

stop_conditions: stop before spawning unless confirmation, registration, and orchestrate preflight are exact and current
stop on missing source selector, unresolved evidence closure with no eligible feedback edge, or exhausted loop capacity
stop on semantic selection, canonical mutation, packet projection, implementation, Git, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production request
